Vulgar Fraction Seven Eighths Symbol

There is no legacy Windows Alt code for Vulgar Fraction Seven Eighths because it is not in either the OEM code page 437 or Windows-1252 tables. The Unicode codepoint is U+215E, which you can use as ⅞ in HTML, \215E in CSS, or type with Alt+8542 on Windows (BMP only). If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly. Vulgar Fraction Seven Eighths is outside both legacy code pages, which is why U+215E is the identifier that works across Word, HTML, CSS, Python and JavaScript. Vulgar Fraction Seven Eighths has no named HTML entity, so use the numeric escape ⅞ or the hex escape ⅞.

How to type vulgar fraction seven eighths on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 8 5 4 2 on the numeric keypad for the decimal codepoint 8542.
  4. Release Alt. The Vulgar Fraction Seven Eighths character (⅞) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type vulgar fraction seven eighths on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Vulgar Fraction Seven Eighths. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Vulgar Fraction Seven Eighths" and click the character to insert it.

How to use vulgar fraction seven eighths in code

  • HTML: or
  • CSS: content:"\215E"; ()
  • Python: \u215E or chr(0x215E)
  • JavaScript: \u215E or String.fromCodePoint(0x215E)
  • JSON: "\u215E"

Frequently asked questions

Is there an Alt code for ⅞?

No legacy Alt code exists for Vulgar Fraction Seven Eighths because it is not in code page 437 or Windows-1252. Use the Unicode codepoint U+215E in HTML, CSS or the Character Viewer instead.

How do I type ⅞ without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ⅞, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+8542 not work?

Alt+8542 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Vulgar Fraction Seven Eighths?

The Unicode codepoint for Vulgar Fraction Seven Eighths is U+215E. You can use this value in HTML as ⅞, in CSS as \215E, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type ⅞ on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+215E, then click it.
